quest.title: When the Trail Goes Cold
quest.description: The Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild appears to be recruiting adventurers for a new and ambitious adventure...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. I trust your adventures are going quite smoothly?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Good. In fact, I have been keeping up with your recent endeavors. I have no doubt that if you continue in this vein, you will become an outstanding adventurer one day.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: As for other Guild activities, I have some adventure intel I would like to share with you, if you are interested.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Another commission for me? Let's hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Haha, your tone suggests you are now exceptionally familiar with the way the Guild handles its affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: However, this time I do not have a commission for you. Rather, I simply have some adventure intel to share.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: It's about Dragonspine, that snowy mountain near Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: The Guild has set up a camp and stationed a number of adventurers there.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I have marked the location on your Map. Once you arrive, please look for an adventurer by the name of Iris. She will brief you on the situation in that area.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: That's all from me. Happy adventuring, and ad astra abyssosque!

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If you really want to go into Dragonspine, you must make sure you are fully prepared — do not underestimate the dangers of the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Dragonspine is not forgiving towards careless adventures.
